questions.question: What is the 8-bit two's complement representation of -45?
In 4-bit two's complement, add 0111 (+7) and 0001 (+1). Does this overflow?
questions.solutionApproach: 0111 + 0001 = 1000. Carry into sign bit = 1, carry out of sign bit = 0; they differ, so overflow. Result 1000 = -8, but the true sum 8 is outside [-8, 7].
questions.answer: Yes, overflow — 7+1=8 exceeds the 4-bit range's max value of 7 (carry-in≠carry-out at sign bit).

questions.question: How many distinct representations does the value 'zero' have in an 8-bit sign-magnitude system?
questions.solutionApproach: Sign-magnitude has TWO zero representations: +0 (00000000) and -0 (10000000).
